status: Design and primary-literature audit; no new causal effect estimated
core_finding: Changing the counterfactual design adds causal credibility. Additional rows, fixed effects, matching and sophisticated estimators do not independently establish exogenous assignment or measure missing all-mode outcomes.
recommendation: Run a retrospective verified-conversion cohort with bounded mode-specific outcomes, alongside a prospective randomized phase-in proposal with aligned measurement.

estimands.outcome: Realized person crossings per hour at fixed screenline or nonduplicated completed journeys in fixed geography
estimands.interpretation: All compatible modes must cover identical boundary/time; realized flow is not capacity or welfare.

estimands.outcome: Door-to-door minutes standardized to baseline origin, destination, departure-time and purpose distribution
estimands.interpretation: Include access, wait, transfer and parking/search; report completed and unserved trip needs to avoid selective-cancellation bias.
Decompose trip count, composition and within-cell time; more valuable new trips can increase minutes despite improved accessibility.

strategies.name: Matched network-cluster randomized phase-in
strategies.feasibility: Prospective; agency agreement required; cannot reconstruct random assignment from existing history
strategies.assignment: Randomize opening windows among already-approved engineering-ready comparable projects; preserve assignment for intention-to-treat
strategies.analysis: Randomization inference at project/network assignment level; prespecified interference exposure and adaptation horizons
strategies.data: Aligned all-mode screenline passengers, classified vehicles and occupancy, full travel-needs/cohort journey diaries or GPS, construction and co-treatment audit
strategies.identifies: Effect of the defined approved conversion package and assigned timing among eligible corridors
assumptions: No unmodeled interference across assigned networks
Measured outcome and defensible attrition handling
failure_tests: Attrition and sensor uptime by assignment
strategies.avoid: Daily physical lane switchbacks fail to capture months-long mode adaptation and carryover.

strategies.name: Verified moving-lane-conversion cohort with exposure-aware staggered DiD
strategies.feasibility: Best retrospective target if enough verified projects have overlapping pre/post outcomes and clean donors
strategies.assignment: Observational project timing; requires conditional untreated parallel trends and no material anticipation
strategies.analysis: Callaway–Sant’Anna group-time ATT or appropriate imputation estimator; never/not-yet-treated and unexposed donors; freeze baseline OD/time weights and network exposure
strategies.data: Project registry plus matched-time counts, Citi Bike OD/time, MTA bus segment times, TLC OD/time, subway entry catchment responses; aggregate total only with compatible passenger boundaries
strategies.identifies: Group-average effect on each measured outcome under stated trend/interference assumptions
assumptions: No anticipation outside declared construction window
Stable measurement and fixed composition weights
No relevant unmeasured treatment-time local shocks
Accurate exposure map and unexposed controls
failure_tests: Rambachan–Roth trend-violation sensitivity with full event covariance
does_not_fix: Endogenous timing from unobserved changing conditions
Cross-network spillovers outside the exposure map
strategies.avoid: Naive staggered two-way-fixed-effects coefficients; adjacent streets as supposedly unaffected controls; controlling away post-treatment mode share or volumes.

strategies.name: Single-project network synthetic counterfactual with honest sensitivity and missing-mode bounds
strategies.feasibility: Useful narrower effect now when one candidate has a long preperiod and credible donor network; total all-mode answer remains conditional on measurement bounds
strategies.assignment: Observational; weighted donor trends or latent outcome structure must forecast untreated outcomes after opening
strategies.analysis: Prespecified SDID/augmented or generalized SC, pre-only fit, held-out pre-validation, simple DiD benchmark, donor and extrapolation diagnostics, trend and occupancy sensitivity
strategies.data: Longer prehistory for measured outcome, unaffected donor outcomes, treatment date/package audit, supported uncertainty bounds on other modes and occupancy
strategies.identifies: Outcome-specific causal effect or sign envelope conditional on counterfactual model and supported measurement bounds
assumptions: Stable counterfactual outcome model or weighted trends
failure_tests: Holdout RMSPE and systematic forecast errors
strategies.avoid: Presenting trip-level standard errors as independent-project uncertainty; calling a manual plus/minus pretrend budget an HonestDiD confidence interval.

method_map.does_not_address: Outcome measurement, spillover design, treatment versions

method_map.addresses: Heterogeneous treatment effects and timing comparisons
Counterfactual balance and imperfect pre-fit under explicit model conditions
method_map.does_not_address: Exogenous assignment, missing modes, bundled treatment

method_map.addresses: Defines and potentially identifies direct and spillover contrasts with unaffected donors
method_map.does_not_address: Unknown residual spillovers or assignment confounding

method_map.addresses: Sensitivity/inference under explicit bounded trend deviations
Supported uncertainty in occupancy, missing modal effects and counterfactual bias
method_map.does_not_address: Unknown quantities with no defensible bound

method_map.addresses: Difference in daytime versus nighttime policy effects if the triple counterfactual trend holds
method_map.does_not_address: Daytime total effect unless the nighttime treatment effect is zero or known

measurement_bounds.screenline_identity: P = o*V_nonbus + B + U_bus_passengers + R_rail_screenline_passengers + W_pedestrians
measurement_bounds.bikeshare_expansion: B = C/s is meaningful only if Citi Bike count C and measured share s refer to the same crossing, geography and time; station starts cannot be expanded into road crossings with a citywide share.
measurement_bounds.contrast: Use period-specific occupancy and expansion factors in the actual DiD/synthetic contrast. A common factor across periods is an additional assumption, not a fact.
measurement_bounds.sign_threshold: If theta_observed is the measured-part effect, omitted effect must exceed -theta_observed for a positive total. Report supported omitted-effect envelope and sampling uncertainty separately.
measurement_bounds.caution: A positive partial sum is not a positive lower bound without a defensible lower bound for omitted effects.

stop_rules: No documented actual moving-lane removal: classify as another bike-infrastructure treatment.
No compatible passenger boundary/time or supported missing-mode bound: do not label outcome total person flow.
No measured door-to-door journey: do not label bus segment or dock-to-dock duration a complete commute.
No credible donor support or severe unbounded treatment-time shock: keep descriptive status.
Perfectly bundled interventions: label package effect; no separate bike-lane causal coefficient.
All candidate controls plausibly exposed: seek larger-network/outside donors or prospective design.
Only one independent project: do not claim millions of trip observations solve assignment uncertainty.
